# Synthetic VakıfBank Worldcard statements

Generated by `tools/synth_vakifbank.py` (fixed seed, byte-identical on every run). Nothing here comes
from a real statement: merchants, amounts, the holder `ORNEK KISI`, the address, the customer number
and the card `4799********0000` are invented. Only the line structure of `page.get_text()` follows
the real layout.

Each `vb-NN-<cut-off>.pdf` has a `vb-NN-<cut-off>.json` with the ground truth: statement fields,
every transaction (installment plans named by `plan_key`), the expected reconciliation buckets and
the expected 12-month installment schedule after that statement.

| File | Scenarios |
|------|-----------|
| vb-01 | zero balance, one page |
| vb-02 | plain purchases, installment A (6x) starts, points cells, subscriptions |
| vb-03 | installment B (3x) starts, purchase that is refunded next month |
| vb-04 | installment cash advance CA1 with BSMV / KKDF / vade farkı, refund |
| vb-05 | early payoff of CA1, last installment of B, tax payment |
| vb-06 | annual card fee |
| vb-07 | last installment of A, foreign currency purchase (USD) |
| vb-08 | installment cash advance CA2 (4x) starts |
| vb-09 | two-page table, subscription price rise (149.99 to 179.99) |
| vb-10 | installment C (12x, `k.Taksit` marker) starts |
| vb-11 | last installment of CA2 |
| vb-12 | installment D (3x) starts |
| vb-13 | partial payment, interest with BSMV / KKDF, installment E (4x) starts |
| vb-14 | last installment of D |
| vb-15 | plans C and E continue beyond the last statement |

The embedded font is a subset of Noto Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) from `pymupdf-fonts`.
Regenerate with `python tools/synth_vakifbank.py`.
